sections.text: Your map reveals roads only under moonlight. Tonight, one silver line crosses a bridge and another winds through an orchard.

consequence.text: A splintered rail cuts your palm.

sections.text: From the bridge, you see a sleeping town and a field of falling stars. A path beside the river reaches the orchard.
The orchard keeper offers you an apple and points out two roads: one toward warm windows, the other toward the stars.

options.description: Eat the apple and travel to town

consequence.text: The fresh apple gives you energy.

sections.text: You arrive as the town wakes. Your map gains a new silver line leading to a welcoming inn.
The stars land as harmless sparks in the grass. You sketch their pattern and discover a road that no map has shown before.
